_doc: Camera/time map for demo/agora/passkey.mov (user's Retina screen capture, 3584x2076, app = 1792x1038 CSS px at 2 px per CSS px). Coordinates are CSS px of the clip frame. warp = [slot_time_s, clip_time_s] breakpoints (piecewise linear: slope 1 = real time, 0 = hold a frame). cam = keyframes [slot_time_s, centre_x, centre_y, crop_width, move_seconds]. hl = lime swipes [slot_time_s, seconds, x, y, w, h]. focus = rects that must stay clear of the checklist (screen top-right).
